# Re:amaze

Re:amaze is a multi-channel customer support platform offering live chat, email, social messaging, and automated workflows.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/re-amaze/.

## Actions

- **Get Response Templates** (read-only): Retrieve response templates for the brand.
- **Get report tags** (read-only): Retrieve a list of tags used in reports.
